lines.text: Hi Mark, did you get the email about tomorrow's budget meeting?
I did. It's been moved to Thursday afternoon because the finance director is traveling.
Thursday works for me, but I'll need the updated sales figures before then.
No problem. I'll send them to you by the end of the day on Wednesday.

questions.explanation: Il dit : the finance director is traveling.
La femme a besoin des updated sales figures, et Mark les enverra.
By the end of the day on Wednesday.

lines.text: Where should I put these boxes of brochures?
In the storage room next to the elevator.
Who's leading the training session on Monday?
Haven't you finished the quarterly report yet?
I'm just adding the final charts.

questions.explanation: Question en Where → un lieu : the storage room next to the elevator.
Question en Who → une personne : Ms. Patel from human resources.
Piège classique de Partie 2 : la réponse ne dit ni yes ni no, mais « I'm just adding the final charts ».
options: Almost, the charts are being added

lines.text: Attention, passengers on flight 482 to Montreal. Due to heavy snow at our destination, departure has been delayed by approximately two hours. Passengers may collect a meal voucher at the service desk near gate 12. We apologize for the inconvenience and will provide another update at 3 p.m.

questions.explanation: Heavy snow = weather conditions. Le TOEIC reformule toujours.
questions.q: What is the reason for the delay?

questions.explanation: Collect a meal voucher at the service desk near gate 12.
questions.q: What can passengers get at the service desk?

questions.explanation: We will provide another update at 3 p.m.

lines.text: Hello, I'm calling about the printers we ordered last week. They were supposed to arrive on Monday.
I'm sorry about that. Our warehouse had a shipping error. I can see your order is now on its way.
When should we expect it? Our new employees start on Thursday.
It should arrive tomorrow morning, and I'll waive the delivery fee for the inconvenience.

questions.explanation: They were supposed to arrive on Monday : la commande est en retard.
Our warehouse had a shipping error.
I'll waive the delivery fee : waive = annuler des frais.
options: A discount on the next order

lines.text: Hello, this message is for Ms. Laurent. This is Daniel calling from Riverside Dental Clinic. Unfortunately, Dr. Chen will be away next Tuesday, so we need to reschedule your appointment. We have openings on Wednesday at 10 a.m. or Friday at 2 p.m. Please call us back at your earliest convenience to confirm a new time. Thank you.

questions.explanation: We need to reschedule your appointment.
Dr. Chen will be away next Tuesday.
Please call us back at your earliest convenience.
questions.q: What is the listener asked to do?
